confidence: moderate — the governing rule is pinned exactly from the cache; the absolute number is not independently reproducible inside the permitted evidence tree (see limits_of_this_oracle)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.quote: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: victim-side amplifier: +7% to ALL damage types, from ALL sources (not just the Mandate holder); 4 s window, refreshed/extended by later immobilizes

sources_quoted.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: victim-side amplifier: +12% to MAGIC damage only, from ALL sources; proximity aura (700 units), no duration

sources_quoted.quote: Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: the two amps compose MULTIPLICATIVELY, not additively
Abyssal Mask carries no magic-resistance SHRED on the target — the modern item is a pure magic-damage amplifier; any model that shreds target MR would be off-source

sources_quoted.quote: m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) ... EXACT ... the mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: amplifiers commute with mitigation and are linear in the damage total, so the leaf is a linear functional of the per-source damage components — which is what makes the delta decomposition below valid

sources_quoted.quote: clipping identity absorbed = min(shield, damage), overkill = max(0, damage-absorbed); absorbed+overkill = damage
sources_quoted.rule_extracted: health_damage = amplified incoming damage minus shield absorption; a shield pool only shifts the implied component sizes below, it cannot change the sign of the delta

correct_model_from_sources.scope: both multipliers are properties of the VICTIM and apply to damage from every attacker in the roster ('from all sources'), not only to the item holder's own damage

step_1_eliminate_additive_vs_multiplicat.test: If C3 had stacked the two amps additively (1 + 0.07 + 0.12 = 1.19) and C4 switched to the wiki-correct multiplicative 1.07*1.12 = 1.1984, the leaf could rise by at most 1.1984/1.19 = 1.007059 (attained only if 100% of the incoming damage were magic).
step_1_eliminate_additive_vs_multiplicat.conclusion: 1.016645 > 1.007059 -> ELIMINATED. The C3->C4 change is not the additive->multiplicative composition fix.

step_2_eliminate_whole_leaf_amp_introduc.test: If either amp had been entirely absent from this leaf at C3 and were introduced wholesale at C4:
step_2_eliminate_whole_leaf_amp_introduc.conclusion: Both overshoot 3072.3 by far -> ELIMINATED. The C4 change is a SCOPED correction to a sub-component of participant[2]'s incoming damage, worth +1.664% of the leaf.

step_3_scoped_corrections_consistent_wit.hypothesis: Abyssal's 12% magic curse was not being credited to a magic component of participant[2]'s incoming damage (e.g. damage from a roster member other than the Abyssal holder); C4 applies it per 'from all sources'.
step_3_scoped_corrections_consistent_wit.implied_component: 50.3 / 0.12 = 419.17 pre-curse (469.47 post-curse), i.e. 13.87% of the leaf is that magic component

step_3_scoped_corrections_consistent_wit.hypothesis: Mandate's 7% Vulnerable was not being credited to part of participant[2]'s incoming damage — either damage from other roster members ('from all sources') or damage landing in the window that 'subsequent immobilizes ... extend'.
step_3_scoped_corrections_consistent_wit.verdict: arithmetically consistent, wiki-faithful; the duration-extension clause is quoted verbatim in the cached passive text and would produce exactly this shape of small tail-of-fight increase

step_4_the_only_story_under_which_the_OL.hypothesis: C4 wrongly broadened the Abyssal curse from magic damage to ALL damage types.
step_4_the_only_story_under_which_the_OL.required_magic_fraction: 1.12 / 1.01664461 = 1.101659 = 1 + 0.12*f  ->  f = 0.8472, i.e. participant[2]'s incoming damage would have to be 84.7% magic
step_4_the_only_story_under_which_the_OL.assessment: Not impossible, but it requires C4 to have authored a change that directly contradicts the cached item text ('12% increased magic damage'), i.e. a regression away from an explicitly sourced constraint, rather than a fix. Every competing hypothesis (step 3) moves the engine TOWARD the cached text's 'from all sources' scope. Weighing the direction of the change against the sources, this story is rejected.

step_5_frozen_baseline.note: 3269.6 is 6.42% above the new value and 8.19% above the old. It reconciles with neither amp model (it is not old*1.07, old*1.12, or old*1.1984), consistent with it being stale across the earlier C-series changes as stated in the question. It carries no evidential weight for this leaf and was not used in the verdict.

independent_computation.conclusion: The wiki-correct model is: magic damage taken by participant[2] = mitigated_raw * 1.07 * 1.12, non-magic = mitigated_raw * 1.07, both credited to EVERY attacker in the roster. The C3->C4 delta of +50.3 (+1.664%) is exactly the size and sign of a scoped 'from all sources' / duration-extension correction and is far too small to be the additive->multiplicative fix or a wholesale amp introduction. 3072.3 is the value consistent with the cached item text; 3022.0 under-credits one of the two victim-side amplifiers.

limits_of_this_oracle.what_could_not_be_verified: The scenario definition (roster membership, champions, levels, items, fight window, damage-type split of participant[2]'s incoming damage) lives in scripts/ and tests/, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids reading. The exported tree (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md) contains no coupled-golden scenario spec — data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json holds 22 unrelated 1v1/probe scenarios and no 'roster' entry.
limits_of_this_oracle.consequence: The absolute value 3072.3 could not be recomputed from first principles; it was adjudicated by (a) pinning the governing rule exactly from the cache, and (b) a closed-form bracketing of the observed delta that eliminates every competing amp-composition hypothesis except the wiki-faithful scoped corrections.
limits_of_this_oracle.what_would_close_it: The scenario's per-source, per-damage-type breakdown of participant[2]'s incoming damage. If that breakdown shows participant[2] taking >=85% magic damage, the step-4 story would have to be re-examined; at any lower magic fraction the new value is the only wiki-consistent one.
